caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped box with a decorated lid, shown separated in two parts to display both the lid and the body. Both surfaces feature a pastoral scene rendered primarily in shades of brown, tan, and yellow, with minor use of other colors for details. The scene wraps around the side of the box and its lid, portraying several human figures dressed in period clothing and hats, along with a horse and several dogs. The background consists of large leafy trees with yellowish foliage and brown trunks. Some figures are seated, while others are standing or holding rifles, with one figure in a standing shooting posture. The middle portion of the box, where the lid meets the base, is edged with a decorative blue and white patterned border. The name "J. Rothenberg" is inscribed in small writing at the bottom left of the image. The composition is centered on the page, and the drawing is executed on a beige background.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
